_comment: Runtime CATS configuration used by src/defense. Identical to cats_default.json except for the image profile, which applies the CATS work package's validated recommendation (CATS_DOCUMENTATION.md sec. 14-15: text alone must not reject an image; ViT threshold ~0.85). Confirmed on the VALIDATION split by src/defense/evaluate.py: benign images accepted 72 -> 79 of 94, blocked 16 -> 10, malicious accepted 0 -> 0.

profiles._comment: Optional per-modality overrides (web / pdf / image / text). Empty = every modality uses the global values above. Example: "image": {"w_visual": 0.8}
